title: Power BI Bulk Export and Download Audit
dataSources: Power BI admin refreshes (`powerbi:admin:refreshes`), admin API (`powerbi:admin:api`), gateway logs, and capacity metrics.
app: Power BI activity events from the Microsoft 365 / Purview audit log and the Power BI Admin & Fabric Capacity Metrics APIs via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:admin:api (activity="ExportReport" OR activity="ExportArtifact" OR activity="AnalyzedByExternalApplication")
| stats count as exports, sum(coalesce(row_count,rows,record_count)) as rows by user_email
| eventstats avg(rows) as avg_rows, stdev(rows) as sd_rows
| where rows>avg_rows+3*sd_rows
| sort - rows
description: Watches Power BI for users exporting or downloading unusually large volumes of data, a signal for both data-exfiltration risk and ungoverned spreadsheet sprawl.
value: Large exports move governed data out of Power BI where it can no longer be controlled; anomaly detection flags the risky ones for review.
implementation: Ingest Power BI export/download events with row counts; schedule daily and alert on 3-sigma export-volume anomalies per user.
visualization: Table of user by export volume, anomaly markers.

references.title: Power BI — Track user activities / audit log

grandmaExplanation: We notice when someone pulls an unusually large amount of data out of Power BI so it can be checked.
